title: Point2SSM++: Self-Supervised Learning of Anatomical Shape Models from Point Clouds
abstract: arXiv:2405.09707v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Correspondence-based statistical shape modeling (SSM) stands as a powerful technology for morphometric analysis in clinical research. SSM facilitates population-level characterization and quantification of anatomical shapes such as bones and organs, aiding in pathology and disease diagnostics and treatment planning. Despite its potential, SSM remains under-utilized in medical research due to the significant overhead associated with automatic construction methods, which demand complete, aligned shape surface representations. Additionally, optimization-based techniques rely on bias-inducing assumptions or templates and have prolonged inference times as the entire cohort is simultaneously optimized. To overcome these challenges, we introduce Point2SSM++, a principled, self-supervised deep learning approach that directly learns correspondence points from point cloud representations of anatomical shapes. translated_title: Point2SSM++：从点云中自监督学习解剖形状模型
translated_abstract: 基于对应关系的统计形状建模（SSM）是临床研究中形态测量分析的一项强大技术。SSM有助于对骨骼和器官等解剖形状进行群体水平的表征与量化，辅助病理与疾病诊断以及治疗规划。尽管潜力巨大，但SSM在医学研究中仍未得到充分利用，其原因在于自动构建方法存在巨大的额外开销，这些方法要求完整且对齐的形状表面表示。此外，基于优化的技术依赖于会引入偏差的假设或模板，并且由于需要对整个队列同时进行优化，推理时间较长。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了Point2SSM++，这是一种原则性的、自监督的深度学习方法，可直接从解剖形状的点云表示中学习对应点。Point2SSM++对……
tldr: 提出了Point2SSM++，一种自监督深度学习方法，可直接从解剖形状的点云表示中学习对应点，无需完整对齐的表面表示，同时避免了传统优化方法带来的偏差和漫长的推理时间。
en_tdlr: Point2SSM++ is a principled self-supervised deep learning approach that directly learns correspondence points from point cloud representations of anatomical shapes, eliminating the need for complete aligned surfaces and overcoming the bias and prolonged inference times of traditional optimization-based SSM methods.
